akhfash:7-7.t: And He said ﴿بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ﴾ when he makes "القَبَسَ" (the firebrand) a badal (substitute) for "الشِّهابِ" (the flame); if he annexes "الشِّهابَ" to "القَبَسِ", he does not put tanwīn on "الشِّهابَ". Both are good.

akhfash:8-8.t: He said ﴿نُودِيَ أَن بُورِكَ﴾, i.e. he was called with that.

akhfash:11-11.t: And He said ﴿إَلاَّ مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْناً بَعْدَ سُوۤءٍ﴾ because ﴿إِلاَّ﴾ enters such speech, like the Arabs' saying: "ما أَشْتَكِي إِلاَّ خَيْراً" (I complain of nothing but good). He did not make his saying "إِلاَّ خَيْراً" refer to the complaint; rather, he knew that when he said to them "I complain of nothing" he would be mentioning good of himself. It is as though he said "I mention nothing but good".

akhfash:13-13.t: And He said ﴿آيَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً﴾, i.e. they make them see until they saw. If you wish you say ﴿مُبْصَرَةً﴾ with fatḥa; some people have read it so, and it is good, meaning "made visible, made clear".

akhfash:16-16.t:
And He said ﴿عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ﴾ because, since they spoke to them, it became like speech. The poet said [in the khafīf metre; this is poetic witness no. 233]:
* صدّها منطق الدجاج عن القصد *
(The speech of the hens turned her away from her purpose.)
And he said [in the rajaz metre; this is poetic witness no. 235]:
* فَصَبَّحَتْ والطَيْرُ لَمْ تَكَلَّم *
(She came in the morning while the birds had not yet spoken.)

akhfash:25-25.t:
And He said ﴿أَلاَّ يَسْجُدُواْ﴾: He means ﴿وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ﴾ so "that they would not prostrate" (لـأَنْ لاّ يَسْجُدُوا). Some read ﴿أَلا يَسْجُدوا﴾ and made it a command, as though he said to them "أَلاَ اسْجُدُوا" (indeed, prostrate!), adding between them the "يَا" of alerting; then he dropped the connective alif in "اِسْجُدُوا" and dropped the alif in "يا" because it was vowelless and met the sīn, so it became ﴿أَلاَ يَسْجُدُوا﴾. In poetry [in the ṭawīl metre; this is poetic witness no. 262]:
أَلاَ يَا سْلِمَى يَا دَاَرَمّيٍ على البِلَى * [وَلاَ زَالَ مُنْهَلاً بِجَرْعَائِكِ القِطْرُ]
(O, be safe, O abode of Mayya, despite decay [and may the rain never cease pouring on your sandy ground].)
It is really: "ألا يا اسْلَمِى".

akhfash:28-28.t: He said ﴿ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ﴾: ﴿ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ﴾ is placed later (in meaning), because the meaning is "so deliver it to them, and see what they return, then turn away from them".

akhfash:30-30.t: And He said ﴿إِنَّهُ مِن سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ﴾ depending on ﴿إِنِّيۤ أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ﴾: ﴿إِنَّهُ مِن سُلَيْمَانَ﴾ and ﴿وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ﴾; "بِسْمِ اللهِ" comes first in meaning.

akhfash:40-40.t: And He said ﴿لِيَبْلُوَنِيۤ أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ﴾, i.e. to see whether I am grateful or ungrateful, like your saying: "جِئْتُ لِأَنْظُرَ أَزَيْدٌ أَفْضَلُ أَمْ عَمْرٌو" (I came to see whether Zayd is better or ʿAmr).

akhfash:47-47.t: And [He said] ﴿قَالُواْ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ﴾: he assimilated the tāʾ into the ṭāʾ because it is from its place of articulation; when you begin with it you say "اِطَّيَّرْنا".

akhfash:48-48.t: And He said ﴿تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ﴾: He used a plural, and they have no singular from its own root, like "ذَوْدٍ" (a small herd of camels).

akhfash:60-60.t: And He said ﴿أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ﴾ ... ﴿أَمَّن يَبْدَأُ ٱلْخَلْقَ﴾ until the passage ends: ﴿مَنْ﴾ here is not interrogative, depending on His word ﴿خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ﴾; it is only equivalent to "الّذِي" (the one who).

akhfash:65-65.t: And He said [قُلْ لا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاَتِ والأَرْضِ] ﴿ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ﴾, as He said ﴿إِلاَّ قَلِيلٌ مِّنْهُمْ﴾; in the reading of Ibn Masʿūd it is ﴿قَلِيلاً﴾. (The nominative is) a badal (substitute) for the first, because you have negated (the act) of it and assigned it to the other.

akhfash:72-72.t: And He said ﴿رَدِفَ لَكُم﴾, and we think it is "رَدِفَكُمْ" (it has followed close behind you); he brought in the lām and made the verb reach (its object) through it, as He said ﴿لِلرُّؤْيَا تَعْبُرُونَ﴾ and ﴿لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ﴾. The Arabs say: "رَدِفَهُ أمْرٌ" (a matter followed him), just as they say "تَبِعَه" and "أَتْبَعَهُ" (it followed him).

akhfash:82-82.t: And He said ﴿أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ﴾, i.e. "because the people…" (بأنَّ النَّاسَ). Some read ﴿إِنَّ النَّاسَ﴾, as He said ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ﴾, whose meaning is only "they say: 'we do not worship them'".

daas-irab:39-40.t:
﴿قالَ عِفْرِيتٌ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْجِنِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of عفريت. ﴿أَنَا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتِيكَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate). It may also be parsed as a khabar [in itself], because it is an active participle. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آتيك. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾: attached to آتيك. ﴿أَنْ تَقُومَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the clause of أن and what follows it is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ مَقامِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تقوم. ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; إنّ and its noun; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قوي. ﴿لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٌ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and قوي and أمين are two khabars of إنّ.
﴿قالَ الَّذِي﴾: the relative noun is the fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾: an adverb of place attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of علم. ﴿أَنَا﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿آتِيكَ﴾: the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِهِ﴾ and ﴿قَبْلَ﴾: both are attached to آتيك, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْ يَرْتَدَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by أن; the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تقوم «[Translator's note: so in the source; in this phrase the verb is يرتد, to which إليك is attached.]». ﴿طَرْفُكَ﴾: the fāʿil of يرتد.
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, joining to something omitted and implied, and لمّا is temporal (ẓarfiyya). ﴿رَآهُ﴾: a past verb and its object; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُسْتَقِرًّا﴾: ḥāl. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾: attached to مستقرا. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿هذا﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لِيَبْلُوَنِي﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative by an implicit أن after the lām of causation; its fāʿil is latent, and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَأَشْكُرُ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the clause أشكر is the mafʿūl bihi of يبلوني, the implied sense being "ليبلو شكري" (to test my gratitude). ﴿أَمْ أَكْفُرُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.
﴿وَمَنْ شَكَرَ﴾: من is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause شكر is the ṣila. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and إنما is [إنّ] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [mā] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَشْكُرُ﴾: the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يشكر. ﴿وَمَنْ كَفَرَ﴾: من is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ, and كفر is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾: the fāʾ falls in the apodosis of the condition, and إنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿رَبِّي﴾: the noun of إنّ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ﴾: two khabars of إنّ, and the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis; the two clauses of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَكِّرُوا﴾: the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نكروا. ﴿عَرْشَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "alter it"; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿نَنْظُرْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); it was also read in the nominative, as a resumption. ﴿أَتَهْتَدِي﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the imperfect verb is nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the mafʿūl bihi of ننظر. ﴿أَمْ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿تَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to تهتدي, and its noun is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿لا يَهْتَدُونَ﴾: لا is negative, and the imperfect verb is nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:42-43.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive. ﴿لما﴾: temporal and conditional. ﴿جاءَتْ﴾: the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قِيلَ﴾: a passive past verb. ﴿أَهكَذا عَرْشُكِ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿هكَذا﴾: the hā is for alerting (tanbīh), the kāf is a preposition, and the kāf with the demonstrative are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); عرشك is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَتْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَأَنَّهُ﴾: كأنّ and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾: the khabar of كأنّ, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَأُوتِينَا﴾: a past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to كأنه هو. ﴿الْعِلْمَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أوتينا, and the hā is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ﴾: كان, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined.
﴿وَصَدَّها﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb and its object. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). ﴿كانَتْ﴾: كان, its noun being omitted; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَعْبُدُ﴾: the clause is the khabar of كانت. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تعبد. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause ﴿صَدَّها..﴾ is conjoined to the clause أوتينا. ﴿إِنَّها﴾: إنّ and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كانَتْ﴾: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine, and its noun is omitted, its implied form being "هي" (she). ﴿مِنْ قَوْمٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كافرين. ﴿كافِرِينَ﴾: the khabar of كان, and the clause is the khabar of إنها.

daas-irab:44-44.t:
«[Translator's note: in the source the Quranic-word markers of this whole entry are damaged: the opening brackets and first letters of the words are lost and the closing bracket appears as «»». The Quranic words are restored below from the Quranic text.]»
﴿قِيلَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهَا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل. ﴿ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, joining to something omitted and implied, its implied form being "دخلته فلما رأته" (she entered it, and when she saw it), and لمّا is temporal and conditional. ﴿رَأَتْهُ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and a first mafʿūl bihi, and لجة is the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَكَشَفَتْ﴾: the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿عَنْ ساقَيْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كشفت; the sign of its genitive is the yāʾ because it is a dual.
﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ﴾: إنّ, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿مُمَرَّدٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿مِنْ قَوارِيرَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a second naʿt; the clause is the object of the saying.
﴿قالَتْ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنِّي﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿ظَلَمْتُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil. ﴿نَفْسِي﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel suited [to the yāʾ]; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause is the khabar of إني, and the clause of إني and its khabar is the object of the saying. ﴿وَأَسْلَمْتُ﴾: the clause is conjoined to ظلمت. ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to أسلمت. ﴿سُلَيْمانَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أسلمت. ﴿رَبِّ﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:45-47.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām falls in the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. ﴿إِلى ثَمُودَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿صالِحاً﴾: badal (substitute). ﴿أَنِ﴾: a particle of explication (tafsīr). ﴿اعْبُدُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and إذا is that of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فَرِيقانِ﴾: khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿يَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾: the clause is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ هم.
﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), in construct, and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لِمَ﴾: the lām is a preposition and ما is interrogative, its alif dropped; both are attached to تستعجلون. ﴿تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِالسَّيِّئَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تستعجلون. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الْحَسَنَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَوْلا﴾: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ﴾: an imperfect verb, the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعلّ and its noun. ﴿تُرْحَمُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of لعلّ.
﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿اطَّيَّرْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿بِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اطيرنا. ﴿وَبِمَنْ﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to بك. ﴿مَعَكَ﴾: an adverb attached to the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun من. ﴿قالَ﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿طائِرُكُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَ اللَّهِ﴾: an adverb attached to the khabar, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿قَوْمٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿تُفْتَنُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

daas-irab:48-49.t:
﴿وَكانَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْمَدِينَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿تِسْعَةُ﴾: the postponed noun of كان, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَهْطٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يُفْسِدُونَ﴾: the clause is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of رهط. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يفسدون. ﴿وَلا يُصْلِحُونَ﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, لا is negative, and يصلحون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is a second naʿt.
﴿قالُوا﴾: the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَقاسَمُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تقاسموا. ﴿لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ﴾: the lām falls in the answer to the oath, and the imperfect verb is indeclinable on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَهْلَهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أهله is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ of لنبيتنه, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: conjunctive. ﴿لَنَقُولَنَّ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِوَلِيِّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to نقولن. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿شَهِدْنا مَهْلِكَ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَهْلَهُ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِنَّا لَصادِقُونَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and إنّ, its noun and its khabar, with the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:50-53.t:
﴿وَمَكَرُوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and a past verb and fāʿil (agent). ﴿مَكْراً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause قالوا. ﴿وَمَكَرْنا مَكْراً﴾: and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ لا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial and the clause after it is a ḥāl (circumstantial); هم is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause لا يشعرون is the khabar (predicate).
﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and انظر is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause انظر is resumptive. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: the fronted khabar of كان. ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿مَكْرِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of انظر. ﴿أَنَّا﴾: أنّ and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿دَمَّرْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of أنّ. ﴿وَقَوْمَهُمْ﴾: conjoined to the hāʾ of دمرناهم. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of the object of دمرناهم, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ.
﴿فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; تلك is mubtadaʾ, بيوتهم is khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خاوِيَةً﴾: ḥāl, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is causal and ما is maṣdariyya; ما and what follows it are an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) خاوية. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾: the preposition and the demonstrative are attached to the fronted khabar of إنّ. ﴿لَآيَةً﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آية is the noun of إنّ. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: the clause is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of قوم; and the clause of إنّ, its noun and its khabar is resumptive.
﴿وَأَنْجَيْنَا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكانُوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and كان and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; its object is omitted, and the clause is the khabar of كان.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿وَلُوطاً﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and [لوطا is] mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember). ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) اذكر. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِقَوْمِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَتَأْتُونَ﴾: the hamza is a particle of interrogation and rebuke, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الْفاحِشَةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ (subject), and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿أَإِنَّكُمْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَتَأْتُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿الرِّجالَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شَهْوَةً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿النِّساءِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of conjunction and transition. ﴿أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar. ﴿تَجْهَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

daas-irab:56-56.t: ﴿فَما﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle and ما is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿جَوابَ قَوْمِهِ﴾: the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان, and قومه is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: a maṣdar-forming particle that puts in the accusative. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is the postponed noun of كان. ﴿أَخْرِجُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿آلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to ﴿لُوطٍ﴾. ﴿مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾: إنّ and its noun, and ﴿أُناسٌ﴾ is its khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīl). ﴿يَتَطَهَّرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of أناس.

daas-irab:57-57.t: ﴿فَأَنْجَيْناهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَهْلَهُ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the accusative pronoun. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿امْرَأَتَهُ﴾: excepted by إلا. ﴿قَدَّرْناها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ الْغابِرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

daas-irab:58-58.t: ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مَطَراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿فَساءَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, and ﴿مَطَرُ﴾ is its fāʿil, annexed to ﴿الْمُنْذَرِينَ﴾; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:59-59.t:
﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَسَلامٌ عَلى عِبادِهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of عباده. ﴿اصْطَفى﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿آللَّهُ خَيْرٌ﴾: the hamza is a particle of interrogation and rebuke; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ and خير is its khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أم﴾: a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, conjoined to the Name of Majesty. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما.

daas-irab:60-60.t:
﴿أم﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) in the sense of بل. ﴿من﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) omitted; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿خَلَقَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ماءً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَنْبَتْنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿حَدائِقَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ذاتَ بَهْجَةٍ﴾: a naʿt (adjective), annexed to بهجة. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted, fronted khabar of كان. ﴿أَنْ تُنْبِتُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿شَجَرَها﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it is in the position of nominative as the postponed noun of كان; and the clause ما كان.. is a naʿt of حدائق.
﴿أَإِلهٌ﴾: the hamza is a particle of rebuking interrogation, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَعَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression. ﴿هُمْ قَوْمٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَعْدِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of قوم.

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿أم﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) in the sense of بل. ﴿من﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) omitted; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قَراراً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿خِلالَها﴾: an adverb that stands in place of the second mafʿūl bihi of جعل. ﴿أَنْهاراً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَجَعَلَ لَها رَواسِيَ﴾: conjoined to the one before it. ﴿وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حاجِزاً﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَإِلهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in the previous ayah. ﴿بَلْ﴾: a particle of digression and transition. ﴿أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:62-62.t: ﴿أم﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) in the sense of بل. ﴿من﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar (predicate) omitted; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُجِيبُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْمُضْطَرَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿دَعاهُ﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَيَكْشِفُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿السُّوءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its first object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿خُلَفاءَ﴾: its second object, annexed to الأرض. ﴿أَإِلهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in ayah 61. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, standing in for the absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿ما تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾: ما is redundant (zāʾida), and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:63-63.t: ﴿أَمَّنْ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿يَهْدِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿فِي ظُلُماتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْبَرِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْبَحْرِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to البر. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يُرْسِلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الرِّياحَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بُشْراً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is the ṣila of من. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place, annexed to ﴿يَدَيْ﴾. ﴿رَحْمَتِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَإِلهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿تَعالَى اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُشْرِكُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما.

daas-irab:64-64.t: ﴿أَمَّنْ يَبْدَؤُا﴾: its i'rab has preceded, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْخَلْقَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ﴾: ثم is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَرْزُقُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila of من. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to السماء. ﴿أَإِلهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هاتُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بُرْهانَكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ﴾: إن is a jussive conditional particle, and كان and its noun. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted.

daas-irab:65-65.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُ﴾: لا is negative, and an imperfect verb. ﴿مَنْ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات. ﴿الْغَيْبَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا اللَّهُ﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the Name of Majesty is a badal (substitute); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial and ما is negative. ﴿يَشْعُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). And ﴿أَيَّانَ﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adverb of time. ﴿يُبْعَثُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause stands in place of the object of يشعرون.

daas-irab:66-66.t: ﴿بَلِ ادَّارَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and transition, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَلِ﴾: likewise a particle of digression and transition. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي شَكٍّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شك; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَلِ﴾: a particle of digression and transition. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar. ﴿عَمُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:67-67.t: ﴿وَقالَ الَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. ﴿أَإِذا﴾: the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and إذا is temporal, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿كُنَّا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿تُراباً﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَآباؤُنا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the noun of كان. ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾: the hamza is likewise a particle of disapproving interrogation, and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَمُخْرَجُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿لَمُخْرَجُونَ﴾: the khabar of إنّ; the nominal clause emphasizes what precedes it.

daas-irab:68-68.t: ﴿لَقَدْ وُعِدْنا﴾: the lām falls in the answer to an omitted oath, قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq), and a passive past verb. ﴿نا﴾: its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿هذا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the answer to an implied oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis) of نا. ﴿وَآباؤُنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and آباؤنا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to نا. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) وعدنا. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle of negation. ﴿هذا﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَساطِيرُ﴾: khabar (predicate), annexed to الأولين. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:69-69.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿سِيرُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَانْظُرُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿انظروا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to سيروا. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾: the postponed noun of كان. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause كيف كان.. stands in place of the two objects of انظروا.

daas-irab:70-70.t:
﴿وَلا تَحْزَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.
The clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا تَكُنْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive by the lā of prohibition, and its noun is latent. ﴿فِي ضَيْقٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of تكن; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ضيق. ﴿يَمْكُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مَتى﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿هذَا﴾: the demonstrative is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْوَعْدُ﴾: badal (substitute); the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾: its khabar; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because what precedes indicates it.

daas-irab:72-72.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَسى﴾: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb, and its noun is latent. ﴿أَنْ يَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and its noun is latent; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of عسى. ﴿رَدِفَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بَعْضُ﴾: the fāʿil of ردف. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: the relative noun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the khabar of يكون. ﴿تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:73-73.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَذُو﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿وذو﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, annexed to ﴿فَضْلٍ﴾. ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فضل; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَكِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لكنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يَشْكُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar of لكنّ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:74-74.t:
﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إنّ and its noun, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿لَيَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما يُعْلِنُونَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding ما. ﴿يُعْلِنُونَ﴾: and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila.
And the clause إن ربك is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:75-75.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negative. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿غائِبَةٍ﴾: a noun genitive in form and nominative in position, as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) غائبة. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السماء. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:76-76.t: ﴿إِنَّ هذَا﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾: badal (substitute) from هذا. ﴿يَقُصُّ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى بَنِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَكْثَرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to الذي. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb after them. ﴿يَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي.

daas-irab:77-77.t: ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿لَهُدىً﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿هدى﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif because of impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَرَحْمَةٌ﴾: conjoined to هدى. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رحمة.

daas-irab:78-78.t: ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿يَقْضِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place. ﴿بِحُكْمِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾: two khabars of إنّ «[Translator's note: so in the source; in context they are the two khabars of the mubtadaʾ هو.]», and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:79-79.t: ﴿فَتَوَكَّلْ﴾: the fāʾ is al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿عَلَى الْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿الْمُبِينِ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of الحق; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:80-80.t: ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿تُسْمِعُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْمَوْتى﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَلا تُسْمِعُ﴾: لا is negative, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الصُّمَّ﴾: first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الدُّعاءَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿وَلَّوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُدْبِرِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).

daas-irab:81-81.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and ما is negative, operating like ليس. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾: its noun. ﴿بِهادِي﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and هادي is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, as the khabar (predicate) of ما. ﴿الْعُمْيِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَنْ ضَلالَتِهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) هادي. ﴿إِنْ تُسْمِعُ﴾: إن is negative, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُؤْمِنُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿هم مسلمون﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and the clause إن تسمع.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:82-82.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿إِذا﴾: temporal, conditional, non-jussive. ﴿وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the clause إذا.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَخْرَجْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿دَابَّةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of دابة; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿تُكَلِّمُهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is a naʿt of دابة. ﴿أَنَّ النَّاسَ﴾: أنّ and its noun. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to what follows them. ﴿لا يُوقِنُونَ﴾: لا is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, the clause كانوا.. is the khabar of أنّ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:83-83.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَوْجاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾: من is a preposition and مَن is relative; [both] are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of فوجا. ﴿يُكَذِّبُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُوزَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:84-84.t: ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿إِذا جاؤُ﴾: [إذا is] temporal, conditional, non-jussive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَكَذَّبْتُمْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of rebuking interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِآياتِي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿عِلْماً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أم﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and transition. ﴿ما﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ذا﴾: khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم.. is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:85-85.t: ﴿وَوَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا يَنْطِقُونَ﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:86-86.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is a particle of interrogation and affirmation (taqrīr). ﴿يَرَوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَنَّا﴾: أنّ and its noun. ﴿جَعَلْنَا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause جعلنا is the khabar (predicate) of أنّ, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أنّ and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of يروا. ﴿لِيَسْكُنُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the interpreted maṣdar from the implicit أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿وَالنَّهارَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الليل. ﴿مُبْصِراً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is genitive by في; [both] are attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the postponed noun of إنّ. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: لقوم is a naʿt (adjective) of آيات, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of قوم, and the nominal clause إنّ.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:87-87.t: ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿يُنْفَخُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي الصُّورِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَفَزِعَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿مَنْ﴾: the relative noun is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿مَنْ﴾: excepted; and ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of من, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَكُلٌّ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); and ﴿أَتَوْهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿داخِرِينَ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:88-88.t: ﴿وَتَرَى الْجِبالَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb «[Translator's note: so in the source; ترى is an imperfect verb.]» whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and الجبال is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿تَحْسَبُها﴾: an imperfect verb and its first object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿جامِدَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and a mubtadaʾ (subject), and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَرَّ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿السَّحابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿صُنْعَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِي﴾: the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty. ﴿أَتْقَنَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿كُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي. ﴿إِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌ﴾: إنّ, its noun and its khabar; the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خبير. ﴿تَفْعَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما.

daas-irab:89-89.t: ﴿مَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جاءَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِالْحَسَنَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَلَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and له is a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the two clauses of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من, and the clause من.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a resumptive particle, and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ فَزَعٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar آمنون. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb annexed to its like; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿آمِنُونَ﴾: khabar.

daas-irab:90-90.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جاءَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِالسَّيِّئَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَكُبَّتْ﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and a passive past verb. ﴿وُجُوهُهُمْ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿هَلْ﴾: a particle of interrogation. ﴿تُجْزَوْنَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ما﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان and its noun. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما.

daas-irab:91-91.t:
﴿إِنَّما﴾: [إنّ] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [mā] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أُمِرْتُ﴾: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿أَنْ أَعْبُدَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿رَبَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿هذِهِ﴾: a demonstrative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْبَلْدَةِ﴾: badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of أمرت.
﴿الَّذِي﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of رب. ﴿حَرَّمَها﴾: a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي. ﴿وَلَهُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and له, a preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿كُلُّ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and its i'rab is clear. ﴿مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of أكون.

daas-irab:92-92.t: ﴿وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿فَمَنِ اهْتَدى﴾: the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and من is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and إنما is [إنّ] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [mā] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يَهْتَدِي﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِنَفْسِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَقُلْ﴾: its i'rab is like that of the one before it. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: kāffa wa-makfūfa. ﴿أَنَا﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:93-93.t: ﴿وَقُلِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿سَيُرِيكُمْ﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, and the kāf is its first object, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَتَعْرِفُونَها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and ما is prohibitive (nāhiya) «[Translator's note: so in the source; ما here is negative (nāfiya), as the source's own description "operating like ليس" indicates.]», operating like ليس. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: its noun, and the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿غافل﴾: a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, as the khabar of ما. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: composed of عن and the relative ما, and [both] are attached to غافل. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. And the clause وما ربك.. is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:1-4.t: ﴿طس﴾ one of the luminous letters (al-ḥurūf al-nūrāniyya); it has no i'rab. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آياتُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الْقُرْآنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَكِتابٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to القرآن. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective (naʿt). ﴿هُدىً﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "it is guidance" (هي هدى), or accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَبُشْرى﴾ conjoined to هدى. ﴿لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of بشرى or of هدى. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they are those who" (هم الذين). ﴿يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ﴾ an imperfect verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكاةَ﴾ an imperfect verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ attached to the verb after them. ﴿يُوقِنُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar, and the clause هم يوقنون is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna, and the relative noun is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and يؤمنون is an imperfect verb and fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ attached to يؤمنون. ﴿زَيَّنَّا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to زينا. ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and هم is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَعْمَهُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:5-7.t: ﴿أُوْلئِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar placed first. ﴿سُوءُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ placed later. ﴿الْعَذابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and هم is mubtadaʾ; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ attached to الأخسرون. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْأَخْسَرُونَ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَإِنَّكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَتُلَقَّى﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and تلقى is a passive imperfect verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and it is the first object. ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنْ﴾ attached to تلقى. ﴿حَكِيمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيمٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) for حكيم. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to an omitted verb. ﴿قالَ مُوسى﴾ the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِأَهْلِهِ﴾ attached to قال. ﴿إِنِّي آنَسْتُ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause آنست is the khabar. ﴿ناراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سَآتِيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent. ﴿مِنْها بِخَبَرٍ﴾ both are attached to the verb سآتيكم. ﴿أَوْ آتِيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿بِشِهابٍ﴾ attached to آتيكم. ﴿قَبَسٍ﴾ a badal for شهاب. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) or circumstantial. ﴿تَصْطَلُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar of laʿalla.

daas-irab:8-10.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and لمّا is adverbial and temporal (ḥīniyya). ﴿جاءَها﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and ها is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نُودِيَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. [Translator's note: so in the source, «مضارع»; نُودِيَ is a past verb.] ﴿أَنْ﴾ explicative. ﴿بُورِكَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is explicative with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no kāf in بُورِكَ, and the source itself goes on to make مَنْ its nāʾib fāʿil.] ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the من before it. ﴿حَوْلَها﴾ an adverb of place attached to something omitted, the ṣila, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَسُبْحانَ اللَّهِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and سبحان is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ a badal (substitute) for الله. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يا مُوسى﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and موسى is the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنَا اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and أنا is the khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of inna. [Translator's note: so in the source; أنا is more commonly taken as the mubtadaʾ and الله as its khabar.] ﴿الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ two further predicates of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَأَلْقِ عَصاكَ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil is latent, and a mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَلَمَّا رَآها﴾ لمّا is adverbial, conditional and non-jussive. ﴿رَآها﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hā is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَهْتَزُّ﴾ the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿كَأَنَّها جَانٌّ﴾ kaʾanna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَلَّى مُدْبِراً﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and مدبرا is ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا مُوسى﴾ the one addressed, with يا. ﴿لا تَخَفْ﴾ لا is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لا يَخافُ لَدَيَّ الْمُرْسَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and لدي is an adverb attached to the verb; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:11-13.t: ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception in the sense of "but" (لكن). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, in the position of accusative. ﴿ظَلَمَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿حُسْناً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (naʿt) of حسنا. ﴿سُوءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَإِنِّي غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two predicates; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ﴾ an imperative whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and a mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي جَيْبِكَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أدخل. ﴿تَخْرُجْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request, its fāʿil latent. ﴿بَيْضاءَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ غَيْرِ﴾ attached to بيضاء. ﴿سُوءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي تِسْعِ﴾ attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "go with nine" (اذهب في تسع). ﴿آياتٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ attached to the omitted verb. ﴿وَقَوْمِهِ﴾ conjoined to فرعون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ the khabar of kāna. ﴿فاسِقِينَ﴾ an adjective. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and لمّا is adverbial and conditional. ﴿جاءَتْهُمْ آياتُنا﴾ a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi placed first and a fāʿil placed later; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُبْصِرَةً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿هذا سِحْرٌ﴾ the hā is for alerting (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject) and سحر is its khabar; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:14-16.t: ﴿وَجَحَدُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to قالوا. ﴿بِها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جحدوا. ﴿وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْها أَنْفُسُهُمْ﴾ a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first and a fāʿil (agent) placed later, and هم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined. ﴿ظُلْماً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَعُلُوًّا﴾ conjoined to ظلما. ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and an imperative whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of kāna placed first. ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause كيف is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of انظر. ﴿الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and the lām occurs in the answer to the oath. ﴿آتَيْنا داوُدَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the answer to an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَسُلَيْمانَ﴾ conjoined to داود. ﴿عِلْماً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقالا﴾ the clause is conjoined to something omitted, its implied form being "so they acted, and they said" (عملا فقالا). ﴿الْحَمْدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ attached to the khabar; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ the relative noun is an adjective (naʿt). ﴿فَضَّلَنا﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلى كَثِيرٍ﴾ attached to فضلنا. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِهِ﴾ attached to an adjective of كثير. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمانُ داوُدَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ يا is a vocative particle, and أيها is the one addressed (munādā). ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ a badal (substitute) for أي, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿عُلِّمْنا﴾ a passive past verb and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object. ﴿مَنْطِقَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الطَّيْرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأُوتِينا﴾ a passive past verb and nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ attached to أوتينا. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ inna, and the demonstrative is its noun. ﴿لَهُوَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and هو is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْفَضْلُ﴾ the khabar of inna. ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ an adjective; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:17-19.t: ﴿وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمانَ جُنُودُهُ﴾ a passive past verb and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and لسليمان is attached to (mutaʿalliq) حشر; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنَ الْجِنِّ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from جنوده. ﴿وَالْإِنْسِ وَالطَّيْرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الجن. ﴿فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and the clause after it is the apodosis of an implied condition; هم is mubtadaʾ (subject), and يوزعون is a passive imperfect verb and nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿أَتَوْا﴾ the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلى وادِ﴾ attached to أتوا; the yāʾ was dropped because two quiescent letters met. ﴿النَّمْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿يا أَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with يا, and النمل is a badal (substitute) for أي. ﴿ادْخُلُوا مَساكِنَكُمْ﴾ an imperative, its fāʿil (agent) and its object, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ﴾ لا is prohibitive, and the imperfect verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. ﴿سُلَيْمانُ﴾ a fāʿil placed later. ﴿وَجُنُودُهُ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ لا يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, هم is mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا يشعرون is the khabar; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿فَتَبَسَّمَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ضاحِكاً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿مِنْ قَوْلِها﴾ attached to the ḥāl. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to تبسم, which is conjoined to something omitted, its implied form being "so he heard, and smiled" (فسمع فتبسم). ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed with an omitted particle; it is muḍāf to the dropped yāʾ of the first person. ﴿أَوْزِعْنِي﴾ a verb of supplication and a first mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent; the vocative clause and what follows it are the object of the speech. ﴿أَنْ أَشْكُرَ﴾ أن is accusative-governing, and the imperfect verb is accusative by أن, its fāʿil latent. ﴿نِعْمَتَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; أن and what follows it are an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ an adjective (naʿt) of نعمتك. ﴿أَنْعَمْتَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾ attached to أنعمت. ﴿وَعَلى والِدَيَّ﴾ conjoined to what went before. ﴿وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صالِحاً﴾ أن and an accusative imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and صالحا is an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿تَرْضاهُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a second adjective of the omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿وَأَدْخِلْنِي﴾ a verb of supplication whose fāʿil is latent, and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِرَحْمَتِكَ﴾ attached to أدخلني, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي عِبادِكَ﴾ attached to أدخلني, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الصَّالِحِينَ﴾ an adjective of عبادك.

daas-irab:20-21.t: ﴿وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِيَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا أَرَى الْهُدْهُدَ﴾ لا is negating, the imperfect verb's fāʿil is latent, and الهدهد is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿أَمْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb), called "disconnected" (munqaṭiʿa). ﴿كانَ﴾ defective (nāqiṣa), its noun a latent pronoun. ﴿مِنَ الْغائِبِينَ﴾ attached to the khabar; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath, and the imperfect verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿شَدِيداً﴾ an adjective (naʿt). ﴿أَوْ لَأَذْبَحَنَّهُ﴾ parsed like لأعذبنه; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِسُلْطانٍ﴾ attached to يأتيني. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:22-24.t: ﴿فَمَكَثَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ﴾ the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) مكث, and بعيد is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَحَطْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِما﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أحطت. ﴿لَمْ تُحِطْ﴾ the imperfect verb is jussive (majzūm) by لم; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to تحط. ﴿وَجِئْتُكَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿مِنْ سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ﴾ both are attached to جئتك. ﴿يَقِينٍ﴾ an adjective (naʿt). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿وَجَدْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿امْرَأَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَمْلِكُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is an adjective of امرأة. ﴿وَأُوتِيَتْ﴾ the clause is conjoined; a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ attached to أوتيت. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَها﴾ the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to a khabar placed first. ﴿عَرْشٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed later; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَجَدْتُها﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَقَوْمَها﴾ conjoined to the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَسْجُدُونَ﴾ the clause is in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلشَّمْسِ﴾ ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ both are attached to يسجدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطانُ أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and لهم is attached to زين; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَصَدَّهُمْ﴾ a past verb and mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ attached to صدهم; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا يَهْتَدُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:25-28.t: ﴿أَلَّا﴾ [أن] is accusative-governing and لا is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿يَسْجُدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are genitive by an omitted lām of causation, and the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) زين. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, a badal (substitute) for the Name of Majesty. ﴿يُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ attached to الخبء. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to السموات. ﴿وَيَعْلَمُ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تُخْفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿وَما تُعْلِنُونَ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ the noun of لا. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the khabar (predicate) of لا is omitted, its implied form being "existent" (موجود). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a badal for the noun of لا. ﴿رَبُّ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He is the Lord" (هو رب). ﴿الْعَرْشِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْعَظِيمِ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); the clause is resumptive like the one before it. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. سننظر: an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَصَدَقْتَ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, and a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْكاذِبِينَ﴾ attached to the khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿اذْهَبْ﴾ the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿بِكِتابِي﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿هذا﴾ an adjective. ﴿فَأَلْقِهْ﴾ an imperative, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ﴾ ثم is a conjunction, and an imperative whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿فَانْظُرْ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿ذا﴾ a demonstrative, its khabar. ﴿يَرْجِعُونَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila of the relative. [Translator's note: so in the source; ذا is called a demonstrative, yet the following clause is called a ṣila, which presupposes ذا as a relative noun (ذا الموصولة).]

daas-irab:29-32.t: ﴿قالَتْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma. ﴿الْمَلَأُ﴾ a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿أُلْقِيَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ألقي. ﴿كِتابٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿كَرِيمٌ﴾ an adjective (naʿt); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مِنْ سُلَيْمانَ﴾ attached to the khabar; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿بِسْمِ﴾ attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I begin" (ابتدئ). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ﴾ two badals of the Name of Majesty. His words بسم الله etc. ... and the clause is the khabar of إنه, by way of quotation (ʿalā al-ḥikāya). ﴿أَلَّا﴾ أن is accusative-governing. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَعْلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are in the position of nominative as a badal for كتاب. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾ attached to تعلوا. ﴿وَأْتُونِي﴾ an imperative and its fāʿil; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مُسْلِمِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿قالَتْ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed. ﴿الْمَلَأُ﴾ a badal; the vocative clause is the object of the speech. ﴿أَفْتُونِي﴾ an imperative, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the object of the speech. ﴿فِي أَمْرِي﴾ attached to أفتوني. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كُنْتُ قاطِعَةً﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَمْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi of قاطعة, whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿تَشْهَدُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتى, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the dropped yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar, are in the position of genitive by حتى, [the two being] attached to قاطعة.
